description: This document defines Tableau calculated fields that are computed at runtime from raw CSV columns. These fields should NOT be expected in the source CSV file.

calculated_fields.description: School Name Title - Combines conference and school for action filter

usage.purpose: Display title that changes based on filter selection

validator_notes: Fields prefixed with 'Calculation_' or having tableau field format '[usr:...:nk]' are computed at runtime
These calculated fields should NOT be validated against CSV headers
Instead, validate that their source_columns exist in the CSV
Validate that the calculated field is correctly computed in the runtime data loading service
